==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{OBP|Gold|Golden Boys}} begins his journey with his {{TP|Gold|Totodile}}.
* Gold encounters {{OBP|Black|Golden Boys}}.
* Gold received a new version of the [[Pokédex]] from [[Professor Oak]].
* [[Whitney]] temporarily takes [[Gold's Pikachu]].
